`r lectureLine(21)`

Block 3 is really all about returning to our old friend, our first friend in SSR, the regression module, because now we are armed with a lot of extra knowledge. The theme of block two was life is mean, but in block 3 we're not going to be looking at categorical predictors, we're going to be looking at continuous predictors, so the theme of block 3 is life is also continuous. We're still going to look at different models that make predictions based on one or more predictor variables, and we still have assumptions to check, because we are still very much going to be working with the linear model. When we have multiple predictor variables, you always need to test for an interaction effect, and hierarchical regression allows you to get a better idea of an individual predictor's contribution.
